failureRetention.rawMedia: unique apps/client/test-results/transport-* directories, including inline JSON/PNG attachments and videos
failureRetention.vitereloads: Initial race runs overlapped source edits or forced generation writes; pages returned to main menu. Isolated final suites passed. These remain failed attempts.
failureRetention.watchdog: 700 ms replacement baseline failed recovery due inherited lastUsable. Reset on teardown; exact failing and passing runs retained.
failureRetention.rate: Two successive corrupted epochs caused invalid recovery and opponent disconnect. Client coalesces across configured rate window; server uses captured rate. Passing final scenario reaches later baseline while preserving connected pair.
failureRetention.reload: After rate repair, cold finalized-room reload crashed when RoomState preceded Context. Guard waits for Context without waiting for baseline/Connected to display a valid result. Retained browser red and page-error-free green.
failureRetention.goSetup: First new rejection regression waited for a broadcast consumed by helper. Corrected test requests a fresh focus broadcast; same pair then rejects unfinished Return and accepts readiness.
failureRetention.environment: Original sandbox cache/listener denials and incorrect pnpm flag forwarding retained in logs/tool transcript; temporary Go cache and authorized local-listener execution used for final checks.
failureRetention.tdd: Initial feature implementation preceded test-boundary confirmation. Those initial checks are post-implementation, not red-first. Watchdog/rate/reload regressions retain actual failing runs before repairs.
failureRetention.probe300ms: Passed probe retained as lifecycle-delayed-red.log; filename is historical and does not make it a red test.
